meta.prompt_suffix: NUMBER RULE: every quoted figure is rendered on ONE unbroken line, never split in the middle of a digit group, and each character of the largest quoted figure is at least one twelfth of the frame height. LETTERING RULE: render only the words quoted above; every other signboard, panel, badge, screen row, box, sheet and wall surface stays blank or carries only bars, chart lines and empty rows — no english text, no latin letters, no fake chinese characters, no gibberish, no invented words, and no company name, ticker symbol or calendar date anywhere. Style: a richly rendered, volumetric semi-3D digital illustration in the visual language of Korean finance-explainer YouTube thumbnails — dimensional forms with real weight, believable materials (brushed metal, glass, brick, paper, fabric, gold), soft ambient occlusion and glossy highlights; every surface has thickness, weight and a light side and a shadow side. A golden sunset or a strong warm key light burns behind the scene and floods it with orange and gold, while the opposite side falls into deep near-black shadow, so the tonal range runs from almost pure black to bright highlight inside one frame. Colours are vivid and poster-like: gold and orange for the winning side, saturated red for loss and danger, saturated green for gain. The frame is CROWDED — signboards, floating panels, round badges, bar charts, thick arrows, stacks of gold coins, cash bundles and household props stacked into every part of the upper picture the way a busy movie poster is, and yet the main figure and the main number still read instantly at thumbnail size. CHARACTER SHEET, identical in every image: a large smooth round off-white head with no hair and no nose, rendered with soft three-dimensional shading and a clean dark outline, always the brightest face in the picture; two big white eyes with round black pupils and visible eyelids; thick solid black eyebrows that change angle with the emotion; a drawn mouth that opens and bends with the emotion; a small simple body in situation clothing with simple rounded hands. If the scene contains more than one person, every one of them is the SAME character with the same head, differing only in clothing, pose and expression. No title overlay text, no captions, no subtitle bars, no large lettering across the frame, no watermark.

thumbnails.prompt_en: COMPOSITION RULE, HIGHEST PRIORITY: the illustration fills the entire 16:9 frame edge to edge — never a letterbox band, never an empty panel, never a flat colour block. The bottom three-eighths of the frame height is filled by the mascot's own dark shoulders and the deeply shadowed floorboards nearest the viewer, so deep in shadow that it reads as one single dark mass with no readable detail, which keeps overlay text legible on top of it. No face, no number, no signboard and no bright object sits in that bottom three-eighths — every face, panel, sign and key object sits in the upper five-eighths, and the upper five-eighths is bright, warm and high-contrast, flooded with golden sunset backlight. The mascot stands just right of centre with its head spanning about 35 percent of the frame height, hugging a huge galvanised bucket that is bigger than its own body. Four ragged holes are punched down the side of the bucket and gold coins and banknotes are pouring out of all four at once, right now, streaming forward and down into the shadow; one rounded hand is clamped uselessly over the topmost hole. To the left, a heavy wooden signboard tilted toward the viewer carries a top line reading "돈이 새는 4단계" in Korean Hangul and a smaller second line in English reading "Four Ways Money Leaks". To the right, a thick white board carries one huge red figure reading "-931만 원" with a smaller line beneath reading "-9,310,000원". Behind them the frame is crowded with floating panels of bars and chart lines only, a toppling stack of gold coins, a burst cash bundle and a cracked ceramic piggy bank, all blank of lettering. The mascot's eyebrows are steep 八-shaped, its mouth is a wide open O, big sweat drops fly off its head.

Detail: a leaning tower of paper cups, a saucer heaped with curled blank receipts, a cardigan sliding off a chair back. RIGHT WORLD, golden: past the glass, morning sun floods the balcony and one mascot is pushing that door open and stepping out right now, a folded laptop under one arm; a wooden signboard hanging beside the door carries one huge green figure reading "+912만 원" with a smaller line beneath reading "+9,120,000원", and a small stack of gold coins sits on the sill. Every head is the same head, each spanning about 30 percent of the frame height so both worlds stay fully visible. The four on the left have arched eyebrows, wide open mouths and flying sweat drops; the one stepping out has flat eyebrows and a small closed smile, its shoulders low and loose.
